title: fix(fields): a data: URI names no image, so the image, avatar and signature cell alt is the translated string (objectui#10493)
body:
Fixes #10493

Clause-②: no

## What changed

A `data:` URI carries no file name, so `readFileValue` now answers the caller's fallback name for it. The image cell reads its images with no fallback name, so a value that carries no name of its own reaches the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` alt. Stored values do not change: the data URI is still the image's `src`, byte for byte. This is a display-name fix only.

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts`: `nameFromUrl` returns `undefined` for a `data:` URI (the scheme is matched case-insensitively), and `readFileValue`'s string arm falls back to `fallbackName` on that. The object arm already fell back when `nameFromUrl` gave nothing. The `FileValueView.name` doc no longer claims "Never empty", because the image cell now asks for an empty fallback.
- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: `displayableImagesOf` is the helper that `ImageCellRenderer` and `SignatureCellRenderer` read images through. It now passes `''` as the fallback name and maps an empty name to `undefined`, instead of passing the literal `'Image'`.

### Why the second half is needed (dispatch hypothesis H2, measured)

With only the `file-value.ts` half in place, every cell pin still failed. The alt was `Image`, the untranslated literal that `displayableImagesOf` passed as the fallback name, so the cell's `imageAlt` helper never reached `t('fields.image.imageAlt', ...)`. The smallest change that lets the translated string apply is in that one helper: pass no fallback name, and read an empty name as absent. `ImageCellRenderer`'s own `imageAlt` wiring and `ImageLightbox` are unchanged, because both already fall through to the translated string when the name is absent. So the lightbox a data-URI thumbnail opens now gets the translated alt and the translated dialog title, too.

One consequence: a bare `sys_file` id carries no name either, so its image-cell alt moves from `Image` to the translated string. That row goes through the same code and is pinned.

## Measured

Base = `f94cfa5`. The dispatch was written against `fee1da5`, but main had moved on; objectui#8677's `SignatureCellRenderer` and `displayableImagesOf` are part of this base.

Pins: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.dataUriAlt-10493.test.tsx` (new), plus five rows in `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.test.ts`.

| Run | Tree | Result | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| pins before the fix | base plus the new pins | 15 failed, 40 passed | 1 |
| pins with only the `file-value.ts` half | same plus that half | 12 failed (every cell row reads alt `Image`), 43 passed | 1 |
| pins with the full fix | `6db588b` | 55 passed | 0 |

Base readings from those failures: alt `png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=` on `image`, `avatar` and `signature`, for the string value and the `{ url }` object alike. A payload holding a `/` was named `cd+ef==`. A bare id was named `Image` under `zh`.

The expected alt is always the pack value read from the imported `en` / `zh` pack and interpolated, never a hand-typed string, and the two locales must differ. The lit control: `https://cdn.example.com/a/photo.png` still names the image `photo.png` on all three cells. A `blob:` URL keeps its last segment, and an explicit `name` on a data-URI object still wins.

### Every other `readFileValue` caller, before and after

Measured with a throwaway probe under `zh` that was never committed. The base leg ran in a comparison worktree at `f94cfa5`, the after leg at `6db588b`. The value was `data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=`, as a string and as `{ url }`; both gave the same readings.

| Caller (call sites) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `FileCellRenderer`, single and array arms (2) | link text and `title` were the base64 text | the translated `fields.file.fileFallback` |
| `FileField` read-only and edit (1) | base64 text and `title` | translated file fallback |
| `FileCell` grid cell, the second `FileField.tsx` site (1) | base64 text and `title`s, and the remove button's accessible name carried the payload | translated file fallback in all three |
| `ImageField` read-only and edit (1) | alt and the enlarge button's name were base64 | alt `Image`, enlarge button `Image`: the untranslated literal, see Acceptance notes |
| `ObjectGallery` in `plugin-list` (1) | reads `url` only | unchanged, because `url` is untouched |

`file-affordance.tsx` is not a caller; it only consumes a `FileValueView`. For a bare-id value every caller renders byte-identically before and after, except `ImageCellRenderer` (`Image` becomes the translated alt).

## Tests and gates

The union was run after the final commit, at `e604834`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/`: 201 files passed and 1 skipped, 3328 tests passed and 7 skipped, exit 0
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2`: 12 of 12 tasks successful, `@object-ui/fields#type-check` a cache miss that executed, exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` does cover the new pin file: an earlier run at `6db588b` failed on that file's pack casts (TS2352), and `4e59a60` fixed them with a structural type.
- eslint on the four changed source and test files, plain form, with `--no-inline-config`: 0 errors, and the same 138 warnings in `index.tsx` as the base blob, with 0 rule/message buckets differing. The narrowing is a measurement, not a skip, on three counts. (1) The population is read from `eslint.config.js`: its `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks cover all four files, and the `--format json` output lists exactly 4 files linted. (2) That count comes from the JSON output. (3) Invariance: the config enables no type-aware parsing (0 hits for `projectService|parserOptions|project:|TypeChecked`, against 9 hits for `files:` as a control), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Exit 0 on each: `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`. `check:changeset-claims` named four pending paragraphs that cite `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (decimals, the relational meta keys, lookup reads). I read all four, and none is falsified by this diff, which touches only `displayableImagesOf` in that file.
- `origin/main` `8740e86` was merged in (merge commit `35e3260`, no rebase), and the branch's diff against it is still these five files.

Changeset: `.changeset/10493-data-uri-no-file-name.md`, a `patch` for `@object-ui/fields`.

## Acceptance notes

- `ImageField` still names a nameless image with the untranslated literal `Image`, because its own `readFileValues` call passes that literal as the fallback name. The alt and the enlarge button's accessible name read `Image` under every locale, and so do the lightbox it opens (alt and dialog title). This was already true of a bare-id value at base. After this PR, a data-URI value lands on the same literal instead of base64. The dispatch ruled it out of this diff, so it is reported to the seat as a finding with its probe.
- `nameFromUrl`'s `decodeURIComponent` throws `URIError: URI malformed` on a segment holding a bare `%`, so `readFileValue('https://cdn.example.com/100%.png')` throws, at base and at head alike. This diff removes the `data:` half of that (a `data:text/plain,100%` value threw at base and names nothing now). The URL half is reported to the seat as a finding and is not changed here.
